title: Hub GCSE History Topic Checklist (Aligned to Edexcel 1HI0)
subtitle: Option P5: Conflict in the Middle East, 1945–95

exam_structure.overview: Tests unfolding period narrative across 3 Key Topics. Q1 Explain two consequences (8m), Q2 Write an analytical narrative (8m), Q3 Explain the importance of two events (16m).

sections.title: Key topic 1: The birth of the state of Israel, 1945–63

topics.title: 1. The British withdrawal and the creation of Israel
points: Conflicting interests & demands of Jews & Arabs within the British Mandate
Key events leading to the end of the British Mandate, partition & the creation of Israel (incl. bombing of the King David Hotel & UN Resolution 181)
Key events of the Arab-Israeli war (1948–49)

topics.title: 2. Aftermath of the 1948–49 war
points: Territorial changes & their impact; refugee status of Palestinian Arabs
Creation of the Israeli Defence Forces & the Law of Return; US aid to Israel
Israel’s relations with Egypt

topics.title: 3. Increased tension, 1955–63
points: Nasser & Egypt’s leadership of the Arab world
Events & significance of Israeli attacks on Gaza in 1955 & Sinai in 1956
Events & significance of the Suez Crisis (1956) (incl. the formation of the UAR in 1958)

topics.title: 1. The Six Day War, 1967
points: Significance: Cairo Conference (1964); Escalating tension between Israel, Syria & Jordan: Syria’s support for Fatah, Israel’s raid on Samu & events of 7 April 1967
Actions of the USSR, Nasser & the USA in the period leading to war
Key events of the war

topics.title: 2. Aftermath of the 1967 war
points: UN Resolution 242 & continued dispute over the Suez Canal
Palestinian refugees & occupied territories: Golan Heights, Gaza Strip, West Bank, Sinai & East Jerusalem

Use of terrorism, Israel’s response & international attitudes towards the Palestine issue: the PFLP airplane hijacks of 1970; Black September & the Munich Olympics; expulsion of the PLO from Jordan (1970)

topics.title: 3. Israel and Egypt, 1967–73
points: Egyptian relations with Israel, the USA, the USSR & other Arab states
Israel’s consolidation of control of the occupied territories
Key events of the Yom Kippur War (1973) & its aftermath

sections.title: Key topic 3: Attempts at a solution, 1974–95

topics.title: 1. Diplomatic negotiations
points: Significance: oil crisis & the involvement of the USA & the USSR
Kissinger, ‘shuttle diplomacy’ & the reopening of the Suez Canal
Sadat’s visit to Israel (1977), Begin’s visit to Egypt (1977), US President Carter & Camp David (1978) & the Treaty of Washington (1979)

topics.title: 2. The Palestinian issue
points: Arafat’s speech to the UN (1974); PLO activities in Lebanon
Israeli reprisals, the invasion of Lebanon (1982) & the results
The Israeli occupied territories & the First Palestinian Intifada (1987–93)

topics.title: 3. Attempts at a solution
points: Significance: Arafat’s renunciation of terrorism in a speech at the UN (1988)
Changing superpower policies in the Middle East: US involvement in the Gulf War (1991) & the end of the Cold War
Arafat, Rabin & the Oslo Accords (1993); founding the Palestinian National Authority; Israel-Jordan peace treaty (1994); Oslo II (1995)
